_comment: Our own half of `minecraft:nether_complexes`, so a fortress can be asked for without a bastion.
Vanilla puts both on one grid of spacing 27, separation 4, picking by weight fortress 2 : bastion 3. Two
independent grids would place both at every site, so each is spaced to carry only its old share:
fortress 27/sqrt(0.4) = 43 sep 6, bastion 27/sqrt(0.6) = 35 sep 5. The salts must differ from each other
and from `nether_complexes`, or the grids coincide.
